paragraphs.text: Talas is a region on the west coast of Caliman , inhabited by dark-skinned humans originally from far to the west of Caliman , who ply the seas and skies as merchants, pirates , and wizards . They dominate the seas and islands with their steam-powered galleons and airships and control some inland timber towns and port towns.
About 30 years before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , the folk of the Talas started harvesting featherwood from the elven forests of Norwood .
The Talas pirates and their cannons still exist in post-apocalyptic Dominaria . They even raided Tolaria West .
